title: Upload a comment image
content_data:
Use this endpoint to upload an image for a new comment or for a reply to an existing comment and receive an `image_uri` that you can include when calling the [/business/comment/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1762228442072066) or [/business/comment/reply/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1762228448779266) endpoint. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/comment/image/upload/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.

Allowed format: `multipart/form-data`.| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |image_file {Required}|file|The image file which will be used to generate a new comment or to add reply to an existing comment thread.

Maximum size: 5 MB.

Maximum resolution: 1080 x 1920 pixels or 1920 x 1080 pixels.

Minimum resolution: 360 x 360 pixels.

File types supported: JPG, JPEG, WebP, or PNG.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/comment/image/upload/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --form 'business_id="{{business_id}}"' \ --form 'image_file=@"{{image_file}}"' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |request_id|string|Unique identifier for the API request.

Note: Please record this field for all API requests. Important for issue reports and troubleshooting.

| |code|integer|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Information](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |data|object|Returned data.| #|image_uri|string|URI for the uploaded image.

Returned when an accepted image type is uploaded.| #|width|integer|Width of the `image_file`.

Example: 720.| #|height|integer|Height of the `image_file`.

Example: 900.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "height": 402, "image_uri": "{{image_uri}}", "width": 428 } } (/code) ```
